mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_message (product_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, content, status) VALUES (#{productId}, #{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{content}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT m.*, fu.username as from_user_name, tu.username as to_user_name, p.title as product_title FROM t_message m LEFT JOIN t_user fu ON m.from_user_id = fu.id LEFT JOIN t_user tu ON m.to_user_id = tu.id LEFT JOIN t_product p ON m.product_id = p.id WHERE m.id = #{id}
